heuristics.name: Empty states have CTAs
heuristics.rule: 100% of empty states must include a call-to-action guiding the user

measurement.method: Navigate to each empty state, verify CTA element exists

heuristics.name: Error states have recovery
heuristics.rule: 100% of error states must have a clear recovery path

measurement.method: Trigger each error state, verify recovery action is visible and functional

heuristics.name: Five UI states per screen
heuristics.rule: Every interactive screen must be designed in 5 states: empty, loading, populated, error, overflow

measurement.method: Check component code for all 5 state branches

heuristics.name: Three visual weight tiers
heuristics.rule: Every screen must have exactly 3 visual weight tiers: primary, secondary, tertiary

measurement.method: Identify distinct font-size/weight clusters per screen

heuristics.name: Primary content dominance
heuristics.rule: Primary content must have at least 1.5x the visual weight of secondary content

measurement.method: Compare computed font-size and area of primary vs secondary elements

heuristics.name: All elements respond to interaction
heuristics.rule: 100% of interactive elements must respond visually to hover and click

measurement.method: Hover and click each interactive element, capture screenshot diff

heuristics.name: All journeys completable
heuristics.rule: 100% of defined user journeys must be completable end-to-end

measurement.method: Execute each journey via browser automation, verify completion

heuristics.name: Lighthouse accessibility score
heuristics.rule: Lighthouse accessibility score must be 90 or above

heuristics.name: Lighthouse performance score
heuristics.rule: Lighthouse performance score must be 80 or above

heuristics.name: Mobile responsive
heuristics.rule: Application must be usable at 375px width with minimum 44px tap targets

measurement.method: Set viewport to 375px, verify layout and measure tap target sizes

heuristics.name: Zero console errors
heuristics.rule: No JavaScript console errors on any page

measurement.method: Navigate all pages, collect console.error output via $B console --errors

heuristics.name: Fast page load
heuristics.rule: Largest Contentful Paint must be under 2000ms

heuristics.name: Limited primary actions
heuristics.rule: No more than 7 primary actions visible at any time

measurement.method: Count visible primary action elements (buttons, links with primary styling)

heuristics.name: Core tasks in 3 clicks
heuristics.rule: Core user tasks must complete in 3 clicks or fewer

measurement.method: Simulate each core journey, count click events

heuristics.name: Consistent typography and color
heuristics.rule: Use at most 2 font families, 5 font sizes, and 8 colors

measurement.method: Parse CSS/Tailwind config for font-family count, font-size count, color count
